relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: After injection of capsaicin in the forehead, the α-CGRP level in the ipsilateral jugular vein increased from 28 +/- 5 to 40 +/- 7 pmol/l (p=0.043)

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: All subjects except one showed trigemino-autonomic symptoms only after injection of capsaicin in the forehead

key_findings: Forehead (V1) capsaicin injection raised ipsilateral jugular alpha-CGRP in healthy subjects; mandibular capsaicin and saline did not
